title: 해양경비법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:2:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2(Contents of Maritime Counter-Terrorism Plans, etc.) Article 2 of Act No. 16 of the Law, concerning maritime counter-terrorism plans, and other similar plans, shall include the following:

1. Analysis of the current situation and outlook for terrorism, both domestically and internationally.
2. Expansion, management, and coordination of maritime counter-terrorism organizations, personnel, facilities, and equipment.
3. Education, training, and improvements to systems to strengthen maritime counter-terrorism capabilities.
4. Collection and exchange of information related to maritime terrorism.
5. Establishment of an organic cooperation system with relevant domestic and international counter-terrorism agencies.
6. Any other matters necessary to strengthen maritime terrorism prevention and response capabilities.
